senses.sense_definition: Een licht prikkelend of kriebelend gevoel geven of ervaren, vaak in ledematen of op de huid

examples.text: Nadat ze te lang op haar been had gezeten, begon haar hele voet te <w>tintelen</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: After sitting on her leg for too long, her whole foot began <w>to tingle</w>.

examples.text: Door de ijzige vrieskou buiten <w>tintelden</w> mijn vingers zodra ik de warme kamer binnenstapte.

target_lang_translations.en: Because of the icy freezing cold outside, my fingers <w>tingled</w> as soon as I stepped into the warm room.

target_lang_definitions.en: To give or experience a slight prickling or tingling sensation, often in limbs or on the skin

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to experience a prickling, stinging, or buzzing sensation on the skin
to experience or cause a fine, sharp tingling feeling
